deepseek.system_prompt: You are a senior ecommerce content strategist and SEO writer creating long-form Shopify blog posts for a golf retailer. Write in British English. Return exactly one valid JSON object with no markdown fences, no commentary, just raw JSON.

prompts.name: Golf Tips & Advice
prompts.text: Write a detailed, practical golf tips blog post for a premium golf retailer. Focus on performance, technique, product fit, and buying confidence. Tone: expert, helpful, and commercially useful without being salesy.

prompts.name: Golf Product Spotlight
prompts.text: Write an in-depth product spotlight blog post for a golf product. Cover who it suits, on-course benefits, performance tradeoffs, and how to choose the right specification. Tone: premium, informative, and authoritative.

prompts.name: Golf Buying Guide
prompts.text: Write a golf buying guide that helps players compare options, understand tradeoffs, and choose the right product for their game. Tone: clear, trustworthy, and practical.

prompts.name: Instructional Guide
prompts.text: Write an instructional golf guide that teaches a specific skill, drill, or improvement area. Use practical steps, common mistakes, and product-relevant advice where helpful. Tone: coach-like, clear, and encouraging.
